chapters.title: Model
chapters.text: Execution nodes are edge-triggered control flow. Data nodes are demand-driven expressions. There is no full-graph interpreter loop.

chapters.title: Execute
chapters.text: Composite runs Blob Array of Execution Headers in order. Selectors pair Qualifier Data Headers of float with Action Execution Headers; last pair is default threshold path; comparisons use strict greater than.

chapters.title: Calculate
chapters.text: Calculate finds Outputs by Burst Type Hash uniqueness or Variable Key. Variable Get reads Grove State with default. Variable Set evaluates Value child, writes, returns.

chapters.title: State
chapters.text: Grove State Key splits Graph Id, optional scope, and key words. Graph State Util Remove Graph State drops entries for one Graph Id only.
